parts:

I am new to shiny, please forgive me if question is already asked and direct me to right link.

I wanted to know how much data set r-shiny can handle, in-terms of no. of rows and no. of columns ?

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Data size handle
parts: That's an extremely general question, as it depends almost entirely on what you're doing with the data. If you're sending it all to the UI as a table, for example, then not that much data (without swamping the browser with data). If you're rendering a plot from it, then quite a lot of data, since all that is being sent to the browser is the rendered plot image.
